title: Processing of fixed spheroids for TOBis barcoding and antibody staining for CyTOF
author: Ralitsa R Madsen

steps.title: Generate Spheroids
steps.instruction: Generate spheroids in Elplasia plates (96-well or 24-well format) following the protocol at dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3byl4bnrrvo5/v1.

steps.title: Fix Spheroids
steps.instruction: Fix the spheroids by adding 16% formaldehyde directly to the culture medium to reach a final concentration of 4%.

substeps.instruction: For 96-well plates: add 50 µL 16% formaldehyde to 150 µL medium.
For 24-well plates: add 500 µL 16% formaldehyde to 1.5 mL medium.
Use an electronic multichannel pipette at low dispensing speed.
Leave the plate covered with foil on ice for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash Spheroids
steps.instruction: Remove the fix solution and wash the spheroids with PBS.

substeps.instruction: Use non-filter aspiration tips (gel-loading tips recommended for 24-well plates) to remove fix solution.
Add 200 µL PBS to 96-well plates or 2 mL PBS to 24-well plates.
Optional: Parafilm and store in the fridge for up to 4 months.

steps.title: Apply TOBis Barcodes
steps.instruction: Label the spheroids with barcodes using MaxPar PBS.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 35-plex or 126-plex barcodes at room temperature, mix, and short-centrifuge.
Remove old PBS and replenish with 72 µL MaxPar PBS (96-well) or 270 µL MaxPar PBS (24-well).
Add 8 µL (96-well) or 30 µL (24-well) of the appropriate barcode solution to each well.
Parafilm the plate and incubate on a rocker overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove Barcodes and Wash
steps.instruction: Remove the barcode solution and wash the cells using Glutathione (GSH) and PBS.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2 mM Glutathione (GSH) in MaxPar CSB (e.g., 49.2 mg GSH in 80 mL CSB), dissolving by shaking for 10-20 minutes at room temperature.
Remove barcode solution and wash with 2 mM GSH in CSB (200 µL for 96-well; 1 mL for 24-well). Incubate for 10 minutes; repeat for a total of 3 washes.
Wash with PBS (200 µL for 96-well; 1 mL for 24-well). Incubate for 10 minutes; repeat for a total of 2 washes.

steps.title: Collect and Pellet Spheroids
steps.instruction: Collect the spheroids into a single tube and pellet them via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Pre-coat a TissueGrinder tube and a 50 mL Falcon tube with 10 mL CSB.

Using a CSB pre-coated tip (P200 for 96-well; P1000 for 24-well), pipette up-and-down forcefully to transfer spheroids to a collection boat, then to the pre-coated 50 mL Falcon using a pre-coated 10 mL stripette.
Perform a final wash of all wells with 5 mL PBS in the boat and collect into the final suspension.
Centrifuge at 800 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature (deceleration break = 5).
If spheroids do not pellet, remove supernatant and transfer to CSB pre-coated 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, then centrifuge at 800 x g for 3 minutes (or let settle by gravity for 5 minutes).

steps.title: Dissociate Spheroids
steps.instruction: Mechanically dissociate the spheroids into single cells using a TissueGrinder.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend spheroids in MaxPar PBS supplemented with 2 mM EDTA to a final volume of ~800 µL.
Transfer the suspension into the lid of an inverted TissueGrinder tube, fitting it between the blades, and screw on the tube.
Dissociate using the 'Harsh' protocol (3 minutes).
Centrifuge the tube at 800 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature (deceleration break = 5).
Wash the blades/strainer with 2 mL CSB without removing the supernatant, then centrifuge again at 800 x g for 5 minutes (deceleration break = 5).
Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL CSB; transfer to a CSB pre-coated 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Cell Counting and Preparation
steps.instruction: Quantify cells and prepare the required amount for staining.

substeps.instruction: Count cells using a haemocytometer (dilute 1:10 in PBS if dense).
Note: Dissociated cells can be stored in CSB for up to 4 weeks at 4 °C.
Transfer the required amount of cells (up to ~4 million per round) to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 800 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Extracellular Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the cell surface with an optimized antibody cocktail.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL extracellular antibody cocktail using CSB as the diluent.
Discard supernatant and add the 50 µL cocktail to the cell pellet.
Incubate for 30 minutes with continuous low-speed vortexing (secure tube with tape).
Add 1 mL CSB and centrifuge at 1500 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the cells to allow intracellular staining.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL of 0.1% Triton X-100 in MaxPar PBS.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes under low-speed vortexing.
Add 1 mL CSB and centrifuge at 1500 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature; discard supernatant.
Place cells on ice for 1 minute.
Resuspend in 200 µL ice-cold 50% methanol (diluted in MaxPar PBS, stored at -20 °C).
Incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Add 1 mL CSB and centrifuge at 1500 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and repeat the CSB wash once more, ensuring all supernatant is removed.

steps.title: Intracellular Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Stain intracellular targets with an optimized antibody cocktail.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL intracellular antibody cocktail using CSB as the diluent.
Add the 50 µL cocktail to the cell pellet.
Incubate for 30 minutes with continuous low-speed vortexing.
Add 1 mL CSB and centrifuge at 1500 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and repeat the CSB wash once more; remove all supernatant.

steps.title: Post-Staining Fixation
steps.instruction: Perform a final fixation to increase debarcoding efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Gently vortex the pellet and add 200 µL of fresh 1.6% formaldehyde solution.
Vortex gently and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add 1 mL CSB and centrifuge at 2000 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare a fresh 1.6% formaldehyde solution with MaxPar PBS.
Dilute 1 µL Intercalator (191-Ir & 193-Ir) in 1 mL Fix & Perm Buffer.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 500 µL of the diluted Intercalator.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in the fridge at 4 °C (up to 72 hours).
Add 1 mL CSB without removing the Intercalator solution and centrifuge at 2000 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Preparation for Acquisition
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for CyTOF acquisition using CAS+ and EQ6 beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant carefully.
Add 2x 500 µL MaxPar CAS+ supplemented with EDTA (final concentration 2 mM; e.g., 4 µL 0.5 M EDTA per 1 mL CAS+).
Transfer the solution in 2x 500 µL rounds to a FACS tube with a 0.35 µm cell strainer lid.
Vortex EQ6 Beads and add them to the cell suspension at a 1:5 ratio (e.g., 250 µL beads to 1 mL cell suspension).
Proceed with sample acquisition on the XT.
